answer.reason: The verses tell what happened in Goshen: Israel settled and multiplied there, and it was spared two of the plagues.

clauses.english: was where Israel settled, and grew and multiplied exceedingly
clauses.quote: and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly

clauses.english: was spared the swarms of flies that filled Egypt
clauses.quote: I will sever in that day the land of Goshen

clauses.english: was spared the hail that struck Egypt
clauses.quote: where the children of Israel were, was there no hail
